summary: Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, Simeprevir received a high risk score of 71 for the liver and a low risk score of 41 for the heart [M]. In research, one study involving the drug was prematurely halted when the sponsor decided to end its program, rather than because of safety or efficacy findings [4]. Another trial assessing a combination tablet that included Simeprevir was stopped due to a decision to discontinue the development of that treatment regimen [6].
